jobs.title: Organic Growth, AI Search & Content Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

Airspeed is looking for an Organic Growth, AI Search & Content Strategy Manager to build and scale how we are discovered, trusted, and chosen across search and AI-powered discovery.

You will own our organic growth strategy across SEO, content, and emerging answer engines, turning customer and market insight into high-quality content that builds authority and drives measurable pipeline. Working closely with Marketing, Product, Engineering, and subject-matter experts, you will shape our editorial strategy, improve our technical foundation, and help define Airspeed’s point of view in the market.

You will help define and execute Airspeed’s approach to Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and AI-search visibility.

This is a highly strategic and hands-on role for someone who understands both traditional search and the changing ways buyers discover brands through AI-powered search experiences.

What You’ll Do

Lead Organic Growth Strategy

  • Own Airspeed’s organic growth strategy across search, content, and AI-powered discovery channels.

  • Set clear goals, KPIs, and reporting for organic traffic, high-intent keyword performance, brand visibility, engagement, conversion, pipeline, and revenue contribution.

  • Identify high-value organic opportunities through keyword research, audience insights, competitive analysis, search-intent mapping, and content gap analysis.

  • Stay ahead of evolving search behavior, search algorithm changes, and emerging AI-search trends.

Build Airspeed’s AI Search and Answer Engine Visibility

  • Develop strategies to improve how Airspeed is surfaced, cited, and represented across AI-powered answer engines and generative search experiences.

  • Create structured content frameworks, direct-answer content, schema markup, and authoritative entity signals that support discoverability in both traditional and AI-driven search.

  • Monitor brand mentions, sentiment, citation frequency, and share of voice across AI-search environments.

  • Partner with internal teams to ensure Airspeed’s content and web presence accurately communicate our expertise, positioning, and category leadership.

Own SEO Strategy and Execution

  • Lead end-to-end SEO strategy across technical, on-page, and off-page SEO.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Web teams to improve site architecture, page speed, technical health, Core Web Vitals, and overall search performance.

  • Drive keyword strategy, content optimization, internal linking, and landing-page improvements.

  • Lead digital PR, backlink acquisition, and authority-building initiatives to strengthen domain authority and topical relevance.

Lead Content Strategy and Editorial Direction

  • Serve as Editor-in-Chief for Airspeed’s thought-leadership and insights content.

  • Build and manage an editorial calendar featuring industry insights, original research, expert interviews, data-driven reports, and high-value educational content.

  • Establish editorial standards and ensure a clear, consistent, and credible brand voice across content.

  • Work closely with internal subject-matter experts, freelance contributors, and cross-functional partners to create content that is useful, differentiated, and commercially impactful.

  • Oversee content distribution and repurposing to maximize the reach and value of each piece of content.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will help Airspeed:

  • Increase organic traffic and rankings for high-intent search terms.

  • Improve brand visibility, citations, and share of voice in AI-powered answer engines.

  • Build a trusted, high-performing thought-leadership platform that supports brand authority and demand generation.

  • Improve website health, technical SEO performance, and conversion from organic channels.

  • Generate measurable pipeline and revenue impact through organic search and content.

What You’ll Bring

  • 6+ years of experience in SEO, organic growth, digital marketing, or content strategy.

  • 2+ years of experience leading organic strategy, editorial strategy, or a high-performing content program.

  • Strong experience with technical SEO, on-page SEO, keyword research, content optimization, and link-building strategy.

  • A strong understanding of how AI-powered search and answer engines discover, evaluate, cite, and surface content.

  • Experience using tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and related SEO or analytics platforms.

  • Excellent writing, editing, storytelling, and editorial judgment.

  • Experience creating content strategies that serve both audience needs and commercial goals.

  • Comfort partnering with Product, Engineering, Web, and senior internal stakeholders.

  • A highly analytical mindset, with the ability to connect organic performance to engagement, conversion, pipeline, and revenue.

  • The ability to operate strategically while remaining comfortable getting hands-on with research, writing, optimization, reporting, and execution.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology company.

  • Experience building a content program from the ground up.

  • Familiarity with structured data, schema markup, knowledge graphs, and entity optimization.

  • Experience managing freelance writers, agencies, or cross-functional content contributors.

  • Experience supporting digital PR, original research, or data-led content campaigns.

jobs.title: Junior Strategy & Operations - Outpost
jobs.description:
🌍 About Outpost

Global expansion is broken. Without a local entity, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Selling internationally is a maze of tax, payments, and operational friction. Most brands avoid it or expand slowly and expensively.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce. Pick only what you need (tax, payments, treasury, or operations) and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we act as Merchant of Record, taking on tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

At Outpost, Operations means problem-solving at scale. We tackle the company's toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. We design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a junior generalist to work inside that engine. You'll be attached to real initiatives across the business - product, onboarding, market launches, finance, GTM - and you'll own concrete pieces of them end to end. Not shadowing, not note-taking: workstreams with your name on them, from day one.

This is a generalist role. You'll value breadth over depth. One week you're cleaning and modelling market data, the next you're running the checklist for a country launch, the week after you're sitting in merchant calls and turning what you heard into a product requirement. If you want to stay in one lane, this isn't for you.

You'll work directly with the founding team. If you're hungry, you'll compress years of learning into months. Most people wait a decade for this proximity. You'll have it in week one.

🧩 What You'll Do

Product

  • Sit close to merchants and the market, and feed what you learn back into the product roadmap

  • Help scope features: gather the pain points, size the opportunity, write the first draft of the spec

  • Track product performance and competitive positioning, and keep the team honest with numbers

Operations & GTM

  • Run and improve processes across onboarding, compliance, and merchant operations

  • Support new market launches: own the checklist of legal, tax, payments, and operational steps and drive it to done

  • Join customer conversations, prepare the materials, chase the follow-ups that keep deals moving

  • Write the playbooks and documentation that let us scale without adding headcount

Finance & Strategy

  • Build and maintain the models behind unit economics, pricing, and market planning

  • Keep KPI tracking and reporting clean, current, and trusted

  • Support the prep for investor updates and board materials

💥 Example Projects

  • Build the first-draft financial model for a new market entry: entity costs, tax rates, payback period

  • Run a merchant through onboarding end to end, document every friction point, and propose the fix

  • Turn our EU VAT compliance steps into a playbook anyone on the team can execute

  • Track and analyse competitive positioning against other MoR platforms, and keep the battle card current

  • Debug a delayed payout across engineering, ops, and compliance, and write up the fix so it never happens twice

  • Take a manual weekly process, automate it with scripts or no-code, and retire it

🧱 What We're Looking For

Ideal background:

  • 0-2 years of experience, or exceptional straight out of university

  • Internships or a first role in high-growth fintech or tech, consulting, banking, or a startup of any kind

  • STEM or quantitative degree preferred, but not required if you can demonstrate analytical horsepower

  • Evidence you've built, run, or fixed something real: a project, a business, a system, an analysis

Signals we care about:

  • Ridiculous bias for action: you solve, not observe

  • Analytically strong: comfortable in a spreadsheet, curious about SQL, allergic to unquantified claims

  • AI-native by instinct: you reach for Claude, scripts, and no-code to do in an hour what takes a day, and you can tell good output from plausible rubbish

  • Precise: in this business a mistake can go to a regulator or a merchant. You check your work before anyone asks

  • Strong EQ: you know how to read a room, a customer, or a blocker

  • Exceptionally hard working: you see work as a core part of your purpose

  • Fluent in ambiguity and chaos: startups are not neat, this will be hard

  • Curious and resourceful: you can figure anything out

  • Clear, quantified achievements on your CV (not vague descriptions)

What this role is not:

  • Not an internship where you watch: you'll carry real workstreams with real deadlines

  • Not a single-function track: you won't specialise in year one, by design

  • Not for someone who needs defined processes and hierarchy to be effective. You'll often be building the process

🚀 Why This Role Is Different

Most junior roles teach you one function inside a machine someone else built. This one puts you inside the room where the machine is being built, across every part of the business: product, finance, GTM, operations.

You'll work directly with a founding team that has done this at scale before. You'll ship things that matter in your first month. And the ceiling is real: we expect whoever takes this role to grow fast, and we'll back you every step of the way.

🧾 What We Offer

  • Ability to own your work and move fast

  • World-class training from operators who've scaled globally

  • A global mission with real impact

  • Low politics, high output

  • A culture of builders, not talkers

🧭 Working Style

We work together in person in London. We believe the hardest problems are solved in the room.

🌎 How to apply

No cover letter. Send us: (1) something you built, with a link; (2) one line on which of the six areas you'd automate first, and how; (3) bonus - pull a public dataset or feed and send a one-screen dashboard.

Outpost is where the hard problems are. If you want to help build the engine behind global trade, we'd love to hear from you.

You will run the full sales cycle for pharmacy accounts across the UK, from first conversation to signed customer, and you will set the standard for how Pharmlogic sells. As we grow, you help shape the team that grows around you, and we all hold each other to a high standard.

 

You report to the CEO and work closely with the founding team. This is a consultative, relationship-led sale into pharmacy owners and groups, won on trust and domain credibility rather than pressure. It suits a full-cycle seller who sources their own pipeline, works without close supervision, and wants to own a function rather than work a list of tasks.

 

Some of the problems you'll be solving

As Pharmacy Partnerships Manager, you'll be:

 

  • Building the engine, not just closing deals: Designing and scaling the sales system that takes Pharmlogic from hundreds of pharmacies to thousands. You own the pipeline and the machine that generates it.

  • Finding the providers ready to grow: Using data intelligently to focus on the pharmacies who stand to gain most from Pharmlogic, independents and multiples alike, and building a repeatable way to reach them at scale.

  • Selling consultatively, winning on trust: Leading discovery and demonstrations with owners, superintendents and group decision-makers, earning the credibility a healthcare sale is won on.

  • Owning the number: Carrying a personal revenue target and running your deals end to end, with the autonomy to close them your way.

  • Setting customers up to win: Owning the handover to onboarding so every pharmacy starts strong and gets full value from day one.

  • Sharpening how we all sell: Bringing the market back into the room, from events, owners and data, so the whole team gets sharper together, from targeting to pitch to product.

 

This could be for you, if

  • You're proven: You've carried a revenue target and hit it, consistently. You're a closer with a track record, not someone who needs the machine built around them first.

  • You can coach, not just sell: You've mentored or led salespeople and you get energy from making others better. As we grow, the team forms around you, and you're the standard they learn from.

  • You are fast. Genuinely fast: You move at a pace most people find hard to keep up with. You reply, follow up, and close while others are still planning. Speed is your edge and you know it.

  • You can forecast: You set targets and call your number with confidence, and you're usually right. You bring commercial clarity, not optimism dressed as a pipeline.

  • You thrive on pace and ownership: You have a driver's mindset, urgent and resourceful, and you build repeatable things in a fast-moving company rather than waiting for one to exist.

  • You know the NHS: Experience selling into the NHS or primary care is a strong advantage. Pharmacy specifically is close to ideal. Not essential if everything above is true, but it's a real head start.

 

What you'll get

You'll be joining a fast-growing company and a small, sharp team focused on making community healthcare thrive.

  • Private medical insurance

What does not move is the bar: we are looking for someone who works at the pace and quality of the best product engineering teams in UK health tech, and who wants the scope that only the first engineer gets.

  • Software that is safe in a clinical context. Our platform touches patient communications and, increasingly, clinical workflows under NHS assurance and clinical safety standards. Reliable, intuitive and safe is the same standard here, not a trade-off against speed.

  • The platform underneath the roadmap. We are becoming the data layer for community healthcare: deeper NHS integration, our own clinical rails, and products that do not exist yet. The boundaries and systems you design now are what all of that gets built on.

  • Experience in healthcare, pharmacy or another regulated domain is a real advantage, and genuine curiosity about it is essential.

  • The scope of engineer number one: real product decisions, and an engineering culture you'll help define further

About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

A single firmware release must serve every vehicle variant we build across both Rivian and all Volkswagen brands. The vehicle configuration platform that the OTA team supports makes that possible: a schema-driven system that defines every configurable attribute of a vehicle and provisions them onto vehicles in the factory, in service, and over the air customer updates. Getting this wrong can mean anything from the wrong information showing on the driver display to a car that needs to be towed in for service.

You will be a technical leader on the team that owns this platform, working as a peer to its lead architect. Where the architect drives the structural evolution of the configuration system itself, you will own the health, reliability, and scalability of everything around it: the compilation and code generation pipelines, the validation and release infrastructure, the provisioning path from schema to vehicle, and the developer experience of every engineer who touches configuration. You will set technical direction for this surface area, drive initiatives that span firmware, build infrastructure, release engineering, OTA, and factory integration across two companies' engineering organizations, and raise the bar for how the team designs, reviews, and ships.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own the technical direction for configuration tooling, validation, and delivery infrastructure, translating platform architecture into a concrete, sequenced roadmap and driving it to completion across teams.

  • Lead initiatives that simplify the platform: consolidating redundant mechanisms, retiring legacy pathways, and reducing the coordination cost of routine changes, while every downstream consumer keeps working.

  • Design the compatibility strategy for data contracts deployed to devices in the field, and build the automated enforcement that makes schema evolution provably safe rather than carefully reviewed.

  • Architect the validation and release pipeline as a product: define what classes of defects must be impossible to merge, and build the layered checks, staged rollouts, and observability that get there.

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for production configuration issues, leading root cause analysis during launches and field events and converting each incident into systemic prevention.

  • Drive alignment across organizational boundaries, negotiating shared contracts, review processes, and release mechanics with firmware, cloud, diagnostics, manufacturing, and partner-brand stakeholders who have differing constraints and conventions.

  • Mentor and multiply the engineers on the team, setting standards through design review, raising the quality of technical writing and decision records, and growing the mid-level engineers toward ownership.

  • Be accountable for the long-term maintenance cost of what the team ships.

 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated ownership of a platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing system used by many teams.

  • A track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives from proposal through delivery, including ones that required deprecating or migrating away from entrenched systems.

  • Deep experience with serialization formats such as Protocol Buffers, including designing schemas with strict backward and forward compatibility guarantees for devices you cannot force-update.

  • Strong Python and working C literacy; real depth in a modern build system such as Bazel, including writing rules and repository-level integration, not just consuming builds.

  • Mature CI/CD and release engineering judgment: you design validation gates and rollout mechanics that encode correctness in automation, and you know which guarantees belong in tooling versus process.

  • Sound judgment under production pressure: you can lead a time-critical fix during a vehicle launch, and you also know when to refuse a shortcut or fence one in and drive its removal afterward.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication with internal and external stakeholders, including the ability to explain tradeoffs to non-software audiences and to write decision documents that hold up over time.

  • The instinct to lead through leverage: you measure your impact by what the team and its users can do without you.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Automotive or embedded domain experience: UDS diagnostics, vehicle variant coding, factory provisioning, or OTA update systems.

  • Rust experience.

  • Experience operating in multi-company or partner-engineering environments with separate review and release processes.

  • Experience with code generation toolchains such as protoc plugins or template-based generators.

  • Familiarity with manifest-based multi-repository workflows.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location:

US-based, Remote East Coast

The impact you will have

Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.

The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if

  • Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests

  • The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time

  • Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration

  • Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported

  • Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact

  • Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced

  • At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit

What you will be doing

Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.

Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830.

Technical accounting. Write the positions and the memos. ASC 606 across three revenue models, ASC 350-40 for internal-use software capitalization, ASC 718 for stock compensation expense, and whatever emerges as stablecoin payment revenue matures.

Revenue and billing systems. Own Tabs as the billing and revenue system of record, including contract configuration, usage data integrity, and the bridge from Tabs to the general ledger.

Cost accounting. Build the payroll allocation method for people whose work splits across functions, and the capitalization policy for development work, so departmental margin reflects where effort actually goes.

Controls. Design and implement controls over revenue, cash, procure to pay, and payroll. Not SOX. Controls that operate, are evidenced, and can be walked by an auditor.

Automation. Evaluate the accounting stack and the processes running on it with a bias toward automation, including agentic tooling where work is rule-bound and high volume. Categorization, reconciliation matching, usage validation, and collections follow-up are the obvious places to start.

Accounting operations. Own AR and collections with your direct report, plus AP and payroll accounting. Employee onboarding and HRIS administration sit with People, not with you.

Tax. Own US tax compliance in coordination with our external advisers, including the income tax provision and sales tax. Coordinate Swiss compliance with our local accountants.

External providers. We produce revenue in-house, our Swiss accountants produce their piece, and our outsourced firm assembles the close. You will own the checklist, the policies, and the reconciliations, so providers execute against a Notabene-owned close rather than holding it themselves.

What you bring

  • Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager at a venture-backed company, with a track record of raising the standard on process rather than just running what exists

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (B2B SaaS Startup)
jobs.description:
Our Mission

Join us in reshaping global trade in a fast-growing startup!

We are traide AI – a VC-backed, B2B deep tech startup based in Berlin, using AI to solve one of the most overlooked yet critical challenges in international trade: customs compliance. Our software automates product classification, reduces regulatory errors, and helps customers save up to 83% of their time.

Trusted by leading brands like Siemens Healthineers, Koro, and Jack Wolfskin, we've achieved 2x growth over the past 12 months – and we're just getting started.


Your tasks

At traide AI, we believe customs specialists deserve smarter, faster workflows and the future of global trade depends on it. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll play a pivotal role in builing robust, AI-powered backend services and infrastructure that drives the value creation for our customers. Your main expertise lies in backend technology but you should not be afraid to contribute to other parts of the application.

You'll join a tight-knit, VC-backed B2B startup - calm but ambitious - where your ideas shape both product and culture.

Product Development

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of new features and improvements in our web application across the whole stack: shaping everything from technical design to production release
  • Write both client-side and server-side code within our well-established codebases
  • Analyse and communicate trade-offs in technical designs in RFC style discussions, drive decisions for your projects
  • Be the backend expert in rotating project teams, give feedback on the contribution of other team members within your area of expertise

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Work alongside designers to shape user flows, evaluate feasibility, and improve interfaces and user experience
  • Partner with AI engineers to bring cutting-edge research and prototypes into production-ready features
  • Contribute your perspective to product discussions, helping set direction with both technical and user impact in mind
Code quality & technical excellence

  • Set and uphold high standards for code quality, architecture, and best practices within the team

  • Design and maintain robust automated tests to ensure reliability and quality at scale

  • Develop and improve instructions, guardrails and feedback mechanisms for coding agents

  • Select and configure tooling that improves developer experience and keeps our CI/CD pipeline efficient

  • Proactively identify and solve technical challenges before they become blockers

Knowledge sharing

  • Share your expertise through code reviews, mentoring, and documentation — helping others level up and ensuring our knowledge grows as the team grows


Who we’re looking for

You're an experienced engineer who cares deeply about craft, but even more about impact. You love clear thinking over hype, and you're energized by the idea of turning AI research into products people actually use every day.

  • 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, ideally building complex products in dynamic environments
  • Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science or a related discipline
  • Deep proficiency in TypeScript, including advanced type-level programming
  • Familiarity with synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns, HTTP APIs (REST and GraphQL), event-driven architecture, and common design patterns.
  • Solid database skills across both relational and non-relational databases such as Postgres and Redis or similar.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud, and the services that typically come with them.
  • You embrace AI tools in your workflow and are driven to master emerging technologies
  • You champion code quality and drive best practices across the team
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments - seeking opportunities to learn, grow, and both give and receive feedback
  • Strong English skills (C1 or better); German is a plus but not required
  • Curiosity about adjacent fields like DevOps, Security, Frontend development, AI Engineering etc.
Our Tech Stack:
  • React & Chakra UI (Component library)
  • GraphQL
  • Node.js & Prisma (ORM)
  • Python & FastAPI & SQLAlchemy
  • Postgres for storage & Redis for caching & messages
  • Terraform / Open Tofu orchestrating Google Cloud Platform


Why us?

  • Varied day-to-day: Every feature comes with unique technical challenges → no two days are the same
  • Visible impact: You'll see the direct results of your work → for both our customers and traide AI
  • Direct impact on product: Your technical decisions shape what we ship and how it performs
  • Team culture: You'll be part of a team that communicates transparently, values humor, and supports each other with respect and sincerity
  • Flexible working: We enjoy working together in our office at Senefelder Platz in Berlin Prenzlauer Berg/Mitte. Home office is also an option for two days per week
  • Be part of our regular team events (boot trips, bowling etc.)
  • Enjoy benefits like an Urban Sports Club membership

jobs.description:
We build humanoid systems: full stack, from hardware and electronics to software and manufacturing, all in-house in Berlin.

At Cell Labs, we push the boundary of what robotics can achieve. Our goal is clear: to build systems that empower humans, not replace them. Our technology is already deployed with industry leading customers and partners. Now, our own product is close to launch.

The quiet phase is over. We are looking for people who want to be here early, take ownership, and help us build what others only talk about.

Location: Berlin (on-site) Start: Asap Employment Type: Full-time

Tasks

  • Mechanical Design & CAD: Design and develop mechanical components and assemblies for humanoid systems, from actuators and kinematic mechanisms to sensor mounts and protective enclosures and model them in CAD (e.g. Onshape).
  • Actuator Kinematics: Design and optimize the kinematic structure of the robot's joints and limbs, including joint layouts, degrees of freedom, ranges of motion, and transmission mechanisms. Select and integrate actuators (motors, gearboxes, encoders) so that torque, speed, and load requirements are met across the full motion range.
  • Production Readiness: Optimize designs for series production with product requirements, user experience, and target cost in mind. Prepare the handover to manufacturing, including assembly processes, jigs and fixtures, and supplier ramp-up.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Prototype and validate mechanical systems for performance, safety, and durability. Design and build test rigs for actuators and subassemblies, including endurance and load testing.
  • Electronics Integration & Wiring: Integrate PCBs, sensors, and batteries into mechanical assemblies, including cable routing and heat management. Build and solder cables and wiring harnesses for prototypes and test setups.
  • Analysis & Materials: Run stress analysis and weight optimization to improve performance and longevity. Research, test, and qualify new materials and processes, such as composites and additive manufacturing.
  • Documentation & Specifications: Maintain complete design documentation, including drawings, part specifications, BOMs, and wiring diagrams, with full traceability throughout development.

Requirements

  • Background: You studied mechanical engineering, mechatronics, robotics, electrical engineering, or something close to it.
  • Experience: At least 3 years working on robotic systems, mobile machinery, or similar electromechanical products. What you built matters more to us than where you built it.
  • Mechanical Design: You've designed complex mechanical systems and understand robot kinematics, actuators, and how mechanical and electrical parts come together in a working robot.
  • Manufacturing: You know CNC machining, injection molding, sheet metal, and additive manufacturing, and you design with mid- and high-volume production in mind. You've worked with suppliers and brought hardware into production.
  • Hands-on: You like building things yourself. You solder cables, put together wiring harnesses, build test rigs, and track down problems on the bench.
  • Tools: You work confidently in Onshape and Autodesk Fusion, including its electronics design tools.
  • Product lifecycle: Ideally, you've taken at least one hardware product all the way from concept to series production.
  • How you work: You get a first prototype built quickly and improve from there. You can keep several projects moving at once and know when a design is good enough to move forward.
  • Languages: Fluent English. German is a plus.

Benefits

  • Your work goes into a real robot: The joints, assemblies, and test rigs you design end up in humanoid robots we build ourselves. You take ownership of real subsystems and see them go from CAD to working hardware.
  • Everything under one roof: Office, workshop, and test rigs are in the same building in Kreuzberg. Your design goes from screen to prototype in days. The electrical and software engineers are a short walk away, not a ticket**.**
  • Room to grow: Paid learning time and a personal budget for courses, conferences, and the tools you need. You'll get space to try new materials, processes, and ideas, and you'll take on more responsibility as the company grows.
  • Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, health, food, or fitness. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about.

Send us your CV and a few projects you've worked on. Ideally, include a mechanical system you designed and built yourself, with a short note on the challenges and how you solved them. No cover letter needed.

Process: Intro call → Technical deep-dive → On-site visit → Offer

We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. We hire on what you can do, and we welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in engineering and tech. If you don't tick every box but think this is your job, apply anyway.

Ihr besonderes Design macht unsere Reisekissen ideal für Short-Form-Videos mit Wow-Effekt: In wenigen Sekunden sieht man, was sie können.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Der kreative Part gehört dir. Du machst aus unserem Rohmaterial Creatives, die hängen bleiben, drehst selbst Short-Form-Videos und sorgst dafür, dass unser Brand Account Woche für Woche konstant postet. Das Ziel ist einfach: unseren Brand-Kanal mit starken, auf TikTok Shop optimierten Videos füllen. Zuschauer sollen kaufen und Creator sehen, welche Angles funktionieren und sich davon inspirieren lassen. Du entscheidest, wie FLOWZOOM auf TikTok aussieht und klingt und arbeitest eng mit unserem TikTok Shop Lead zusammen, der Kanalstrategie und Produktkatalog verantwortet.

Deine Aufgaben

Creatives-Erstellung:

  • Du schneidest Short-Form-Videos aus unserem bestehenden Rohmaterial, aus Material vom Team und aus deinem eigenen Footage (neue Hooks, neue Cuts, TikTok-Style)

  • Du veröffentlichst auf unserem Brand Account, hältst einen konstanten Posting-Rhythmus und gehst in den Austausch mit der Community
  • Du bereitest die besten Videos gemeinsam mit dem Social-Media-Team für Instagram und Facebook auf

Content-Analyse:

  • Du prüfst wöchentlich wie die Videos performt haben und verstehst warum (Hook, Format, CTA und Länge dokumentieren)
  • Du hältst fest, was funktioniert – damit wir Creator-Briefings schärfen, unsere eigenen Videos verbessern und die stärksten Videos mit Ads boosten können
  • Du hältst unsere Video-Bibliothek in Ordnung und dokumentierst systematisch Nutzungsrechte

Unterstützung im Creator Management:

  • Du unterstützt bei Outreach, Onboarding und Aktivierung unserer TikTok-Shop-Affiliate-Creator – zum Beispiel, indem du Briefings verbesserst oder inaktiven Creatorn Beispielvideos schickst

Der Content, den wir im Kopf haben

  • Ein Startpunkt, den du mitgestaltest:
  • Du testest einen Mix aus Formaten: Videos mit dir vor der Kamera, faceless Content (POV, Voiceover, Produkt in Action) sowie Clips von Team und Creatorn

  • Unser Account postet konstant 4–5 Videos pro Woche, in einem Format-Mix, der nach FLOWZOOM klingt
  • Wir haben 2–3 wiederkehrende Formate gefunden, die am besten funktionieren
  • Wir kennen unsere Top 3–5 Hooks und Formate – und sie sind dokumentiert
  • Die Video-Bibliothek ist sortiert und bei jedem Clip sind die Nutzungsrechte klar

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

Must-haves:

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Short-Form-Editing – idealerweise ein Portfolio an TikToks, Reels oder Shorts, das du zeigen kannst
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Schnitt-Tools (z. B. CapCut, Premiere oder Final Cut)
  • Du fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl
  • Du kannst die Performance eines Videos anhand von KPIs analysieren (z. B. Engagement, Retention …)
  • Du hast ein Gespür für TikTok, für Trends und für das, was Leute gern schauen
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenständig
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und du sprichst fließend Englisch (unsere Teamsprache)

Nice-to-have:

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Affiliate- oder Creator-Marketing

Nicht erforderlich:

  • TikTok-Shop-Erfahrung. Ein Hintergrund in Content, Social Media oder E-Commerce zählt genauso.

  • Werkstudium: Wir starten bei 16–18 EUR brutto pro Stunde, das sind rund 1.400–1.550 EUR brutto im Monat bei 20 Stunden/Woche. Wenn es gut läuft, ist Luft nach oben!

This is an Atlantic portfolio company.

Why we exist

Every frontier model is now gated by two things: megawatts and cooling. Grid queues stretch for years, land is contested, freshwater is political.

Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on Earth, a vast resource the grid can, by definition, never reach.

So we flipped the problem. Instead of bringing power to the load, we bring the load to the power. Our autonomous wind-turbine energy ships chase the wind across the open ocean and convert it on board into what the world needs most: compute first, then e-fuels to decarbonise aviation.

  • 70%+ capacity factor — offshore wind that behaves like baseload

  • ~€50/MWh target cost for firm, low-carbon power

  • Zero grid queue. Zero freshwater. Zero land. And the ocean as the heat sink under every rack.

Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs (with successful exits) and industrial operators. Backed by major international investors. First demonstrator vessel at sea in late 2027.

The role

This is not a sales job. It's a late co-founder seat. You will own Offshore Compute, our first and main commercial engine: strategy, product, pricing, customers and the multi-million-dollar off-take deals that put our first fleet to work.

You already know that power and thermal limits are what will stall AI scaling. You're bold enough to believe infrastructure at sea can get around both, and rigorous enough to prove it to a sceptical buyer.

What you'll do

  • Turn variable power into a feature. Design offers built for wind-backed power profiles: fault-tolerant batch training, asynchronous inference, dynamic pricing, zero-carbon AI clouds.

  • Connect the C-suite to the hull. Translate client requirements (SLA, latency, direct-to-chip liquid cooling) into onboard architecture specs together with our marine engineers.

  • Create a category. Use our advantages — no grid wait, no freshwater, a direct ocean cooling sink, very low carbon intensity — to win premium pricing and long-term commitments, and establish floating compute as a new asset class.

You might be the one if

  • You speak the physics. MW-scale power delivery, PUE, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, thermal budgets. You can explain in one slide why land-based data centers are hitting the grid wall.

  • You've built something from zero. You've scaled a business line, closed complex multi-million infrastructure contracts and thrived with high autonomy and high ambiguity.

  • The ocean pulls at you. You care about climate, and standing on the deck of a floating compute lab during sea trials sounds like the best day of your year.

  • You work in English. Fluent English is required. French is a bonus.

How you operate

  • Owner, not operator. You don't wait for a playbook. You write it.

  • Maths over rhetoric. When a buyer is sceptical about offshore compute, you open the energy and thermal maths.

  • Realistic madness. You have the conviction to break paradigms and the engineering and commercial discipline to deliver.

  • Humble and brave. You stay intellectually humble and still take bold positions, especially where conventional playbooks fail.

  • AI-native. You use modern AI tools for maximum leverage while keeping the domain authority to negotiate directly with C-level executives.

What's in it for you

  • A real shot at creating a new asset class at the intersection of AI, energy and the ocean

  • A small, uncompromising team of entrepreneurs and industrial leaders, backed by top-tier capital

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Search (remote, Europe)
jobs.description:
Hey, I'm Adrian. I’m hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Data Search team at Modash.

Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies—including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN—use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships.

Behind that product is a fascinating search problem: helping customers find the right people across 400M+ creator profiles and billions of media files. We’re combining large-scale data processing, traditional retrieval, vector search, multimodal embeddings, and LLMs to make that possible.

That’s where you come in.

Why we're hiring

Search at Modash isn't an internal platform or a support function. It is one of the core products customers use to discover creators.

The scale is large, the data is messy, and the search intent is often complex. A customer might be looking for creators in a specific niche, people whose content conveys a certain visual style, or accounts that resemble a group they already know. Solving that well requires more than adding another filter or calling an LLM API.

We need a senior engineer who can work across the full retrieval system—from data and indexing pipelines to embeddings, ranking, relevance, and low-latency serving—and take ambiguous product problems all the way to production.

You’ll join the specialised Data Search team and work closely with Data Core, Data Insights, product teams, customers, and company leadership. You’ll have real autonomy, but you won’t work in isolation.

If you want a feel for how we think about building software, check our Engineering Blog.

What you'll actually own

1. Make creator search meaningfully better.

You’ll improve how customers discover creators across 400M+ profiles and billions of media files. That includes retrieval, filtering, ranking, relevance, speed, and the product decisions that connect them.

2. Turn multimodal data into searchable intelligence.

You’ll build systems that generate and use embeddings from images, video, text, and audio at massive scale—then make those signals useful in a real customer-facing search experience.

3. Ship new search capabilities into production.

You’ll evaluate models and technologies pragmatically, understand tradeoffs around cost, latency, and quality, and move promising approaches from experiment to a reliable production system within weeks rather than quarters.

4. Own the system end to end.

You’ll help shape the problem, gather requirements, design the architecture, write the code, release it, measure the outcome, and improve it. Senior engineers here own results, not just implementation tasks.

What the day-to-day looks like

Here’s what a typical week might include:

  • Monday. A customer search is returning technically relevant but unhelpful results. You inspect the retrieval and ranking stages, identify where intent is being lost, and propose a measurable improvement.
  • Tuesday. Deep-focus time. You build a pipeline to generate multimodal embeddings across a large batch of creator content and test how the new representation affects retrieval quality and cost.
  • Wednesday. You work with Data Insights on a new in-house datapoint. Together, you agree on its definition, coverage, and data-quality requirements, then expose it in Search to give customers more ways to discover creators.
  • Thursday. You test a reranking model on a fixed set of real customer queries. You measure how much it improves relevance against the latency and inference cost it adds, then decide what's ready for production.
  • Friday. You review production metrics, investigate a relevance regression, and share what you learned with the team. The fix may be in the model, the data, the query logic, or the product itself—you follow the evidence.

We keep meetings purposeful and protect time for deep work. You’ll have a short standup, close collaboration when it helps, and plenty of space to design, build, optimise, and launch.

Requirements

What you've done before

  • Built large-scale data or backend products. You have solid experience working with systems where volume, latency, reliability, and cost all matter.
  • Shipped products from concept to production. You’ve owned scoping, architecture, implementation, release, measurement, and iteration—not just one layer of the solution.
  • Designed distributed systems. You can reason clearly about throughput, failure modes, data flow, scalability, and operational tradeoffs.
  • Built LLM-powered or agentic features in production. You understand the practical differences between models and can balance capability against latency and cost.
  • Worked autonomously on ambiguous problems. You know how to gather requirements, ask useful questions, and turn incomplete context into forward motion.
  • Communicated clearly across teams. You can explain technical tradeoffs to engineers and non-engineers, give direct feedback, and collaborate without creating unnecessary process.
  • Worked in a fast-moving product environment. You’re comfortable learning quickly, shipping incrementally, and changing direction when the evidence does.

Bonus points if you’ve worked with multimodal embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, ranking algorithms, model deployment, self-hosted models, or GPU infrastructure. Curiosity about the creator economy helps too, but we’ll get you up to speed.

Our stack

  • AWS and GCP, with Pulumi for infrastructure as code
  • Python, TypeScript, and Node.js
  • PySpark on AWS EMR
  • Airflow
  • Milvus Vector DB through Zilliz
  • Elasticsearch
  • LLM batch APIs
  • Apache Iceberg
  • SageMaker, DynamoDB, S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, ECS, and Aurora
  • Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion, and Cursor

The interview process

We move quickly and can complete the process in under a week:

  1. Intro chat
  2. Coding interview
  3. System design interview
  4. Team interview
  5. Culture and alignment conversation with our CEO, Avery Schrader

Benefits

What we offer

  • Fully remote in Europe 🏠 Work from wherever you do your best work, with some overlap with GMT+3.
  • Compensation. Your compensation is made up of salary and stock options. As we're growing fast, the stock option package is especially significant. Annual salary range is 100,000€ - 130,000€ for this role. We hire across Europe, so the exact number depends on your location, employment type, skills, and experience.
  • Flexible hours ⏱ We care about outcomes, not when you log on.
  • Unlimited paid vacation 🌴 If you’re rested and happy, you do better work. Take what you need.
  • Personal development support 🧠 Courses, books, and conferences are on us when they help you grow.
  • Real ownership 💡 Take difficult search problems from idea to production without layers of unnecessary process.
  • Regular offsites ✈️ We’re remote-first, but we make time to connect, collaborate, and have fun together in person.

And a little more about us...

Founded in 2018 by a high-school dropout and a Canadian (yes, we’re also shocked it’s going so well), Modash is building a suite of tools that help brands scale partnerships with online content creators.

2,700+ companies like Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN already use Modash to manage and scale their influencer marketing work. And we're just getting started. Over the coming decade, brand investment in creators will continue to boom, and Modash will be at the centre of it all.

Modash is here to stay. We have 8-figures in ARR across two products, a $12M series A investment, and we are default alive. We are building a company that will still be here in 20 years; not rushing towards an exit.

We’re almost 100 people distributed across 20+ countries, operating with a fast, async-first culture. If you join Modash, you’ll be surrounded by people who truly want to be the greatest at their craft. People who make you better. Interesting people too, who have done everything from building solar cars, to hanging out with Metallica and Bon Jovi.

Come join us. Be great, do great things, create great memories, all while making a great impact. Do it.

Retail Sales Manager / Vertriebsmitarbeiter (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

 

Wolt ist im August 2020 in Deutschland gestartet und hat zunächst Kund:innen in Berlin mit großartigen lokalen Restaurants verbunden. Seitdem haben wir uns zu einer führenden Plattform für lokalen Handel entwickelt – und bringen heute alles von Lebensmitteln und Drogerieartikeln über Blumen und Home-&-Living-Produkte bis hin zu Unterhaltungselektronik direkt an die Haustür unserer Kund:innen.

Jetzt ist ein besonders spannender Zeitpunkt, Teil unseres Retail-Teams zu werden. Wolt wächst in Deutschland rasant und arbeitet mit einigen der bekanntesten Handelsmarken des Landes zusammen. Zuletzt haben wir unsere Partnerschaft mit MediaMarktSaturn gestartet: Rund 2.000 Elektronikartikel – von Smartphones bis zu Spielkonsolen – können in großen deutschen Städten, darunter Berlin, innerhalb von etwa 35 Minuten geliefert werden.

Wir bauen unser Retail-Geschäft in Deutschland nun deutlich aus und suchen ambitionierte Sales-Talente, die gemeinsam mit uns die besten lokalen Handelspartner auf die Wolt-Plattform bringen. In dieser Rolle gestaltest du den On-Demand-Handel in Berlin aktiv mit, gewinnst hochwertige Partner und hilfst dabei, neu zu definieren, wie Menschen lokal einkaufen.

Erfahre mehr über unsere Partnerschaft mit MediaMarktSaturn und entdecke die neuesten Updates im Wolt Deutschland Newsroom.

Deine Hauptaufgaben bei Wolt

  • Identifikation & Akquise: Du bist verantwortlich für das Sourcing der besten Retail-Partner der Stadt. Dein Ziel ist es, Supermärkte und erstklassige Non-Food-Venues im Raum Berlin zu gewinnen und diese zu optimalen Konditionen auf die Wolt-Plattform zu bringen.
  • Pipeline-Management: Du steuerst deine Sales-Pipeline eigenständig und baust belastbare Netzwerke zu Inhaber:innen sowie Geschäftsleiter:innen im Einzelhandel auf.
  • Überzeugende Präsentation: Du positionierst Wolt als führende E-Commerce-Lösung. Dabei hörst du potenziellen Partnern aktiv zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und überzeugst Entscheidungsträger durch passgenaue Mehrwerte.
  • Präsenz vor Ort: Dein Fokus liegt auf dem Außendienst. Deine Woche besteht aus ca. 1–2 Tagen strategischer Planung und Cold Calling (Home Office) sowie 3–4 Tagen im Außendienst in Berlin (inkl. gelegentlicher Hotelübernachtungen).
  • Schnittstellenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Onboarding-Team zusammen, um eine perfekte Abbildung deiner Partner – vom Supermarkt bis zum Blumenladen – auf unserer Plattform sicherzustellen.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Vertriebsprofi im Außendienst: Du hast bereits 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Sales und liebst den Kaltkundenkontakt. Es motiviert dich, Partner proaktiv vor Ort zu besuchen und zu überzeugen.
  • Hohe Anpassungsfähigkeit: Du kommunizierst souverän auf Augenhöhe – vom Blumenladen bis zum C-Level-Entscheider. Dabei bleibst du immer authentisch und zielorientiert.
  • Performance-Drive: Du willst der Beste sein und die Top-Retail-Partner der Stadt für Wolt gewinnen, um unseren Marktanteil signifikant auszubauen.
  • Selbstorganisation: Du planst deine Walk-in-Routen effizient, trackst deine Aktivitäten eigenständig und managest deine Pipeline absolut zuverlässig.
  • Positives Mindset: Du bist hartnäckig, denkst lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei Gegenwind deine positive Ausstrahlung.
  • Qualifikation & Sprache: Studium oder Ausbildung, fließendes Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Was wir dir anbieten:

  • Gestalte die Zukunft des Handels: Wir verändern, wie Menschen einkaufen. Dein Job ist es, den lokalen Handel so effizient zu machen, dass unsere Kunden Zeit für Wichtigeres gewinnen, anstatt sie in Warteschlangen im Supermarkt zu verbringen.
  • Wachstum & Impact: Nutze die steile Lernkurve eines globalen Tech-Unternehmens und entwickle unsere bereits etablierten Märkte in Berlin auf das nächste Level.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Arbeite selbständig in einem dynamischen Team mit flachen Hierarchien und direktem Einfluss auf den Markterfolg.
  • Mobilität & Equipment: Du erhältst Top-Hardware (iPhone & MacBook) und die Option auf einen Firmenwagen für deine Einsätze im Außendienst.
  • Wolt-Benefits: Rabatte auf Wolt-Bestellungen, ÖPNV-Zuschuss sowie Wellness-Angebote (z. B. Urban Sports Club).
  • Work-Life-Balance: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten. 

Nächste Schritte

Unser Bewerbungsprozess ist unkompliziert und transparent:

  1. Recruiter Screening: Ein erstes Gespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team, um dich, deine bisherige Erfahrung und deine Motivation für Wolt kennenzulernen.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview: Ein vertiefendes Gespräch mit dem Hiring Manager, in dem wir mehr über deine Vertriebserfahrung, deine Arbeitsweise und deine Motivation für die Rolle erfahren möchten.
  3. Role Play: Eine praxisnahe Sales-Übung, bei der du uns deinen Ansatz bei der Kundenansprache, im Pitch und im Umgang mit Einwänden zeigen kannst.

Bereit, mit uns Geschichte zu schreiben?

Wir verändern nicht nur den Handel – wir geben den Menschen Zeit für das zurück, was sie wirklich lieben. Wenn du in einem High-Growth-Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen willst und ein Team suchst, das Ambition mit Spaß verbindet, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Bewirb dich jetzt und lass uns gemeinsam den Markt revolutionieren!

Wichtiger Hinweis: Um deine Daten bestmöglich zu schützen (GDPR), akzeptieren wir keine Bewerbungen per E-Mail. Bitte nutze ausschließlich unsere Karriereseite für deine Bewerbung. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (all genders)
jobs.description:
JustPlay is looking for a Senior Product Designer (all genders) to contribute to shaping the design vision and elevate our product design function. This is your chance to make a lasting impact on a platform used by millions — with a focus on content discovery, player motivation, and engagement design. You’ll bring proven expertise in gamification, with a demonstrated ability to create experiences that inspire players and drive retention.

You’ll drive business impact through design, ensuring every player interaction contributes to JustPlay’s growth and mission. You’ll also help unlock operational efficiency by integrating AI tools and workflows across the digital product development lifecycle, helping teams move faster and smarter.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to deliver both bold long-term ideas and immediate, high-impact improvements.

 

Job Requirements

  • 2-3 years of experience designing end-to-end mobile product experiences, ideally in gaming or entertainment

  • Experience scaling or refining established design teams and processes

  • A portfolio showcasing impactful mobile design work

  • Proven expertise in gamification and user engagement

  • Expert proficiency in Figma

  • Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to craft

  • You communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.

Nice to Have

  • Background in loyalty or rewards platforms

  • Mobile gaming experience.

  • Deep understanding of mobile gaming trends and the advertising landscape

 

Job Responsibilities

Hands-On Design

  • Contribute to user experience from conception to launch, developing and advocating the design vision for one of the world's top entertainment apps

  • Create user-centric designs, wireframes, prototypes, and mockups for the JustPlay app

  • Develop features that elevate the entire player journey, with emphasis on game discovery and loyalty gamification

  • Drive measurable business outcomes through design decisions that balance player delight and company growth

  • Support evolving JustPlay's design guidelines and design system

Collaboration & Strategy

  • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to develop innovative solutions within technical constraints

  • Apply platform best practices (iOS, Android) to ensure design quality and seamless interactions across devices

  • Transform research insights and analytics into actionable design concepts

  • Work with cross-functional leaders to identify where AI and automation can streamline design operations

Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and maintain effective design processes that scale with your team

  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance product usability

  • Stay current with mobile gaming trends and the advertising ecosystem

  • Foster a high-performing, growth-minded design team through mentorship and feedback

  • Champion product design throughout the organization, educating stakeholders and establishing design-led practices

  • Contribute to building a culture of craft, collaboration, and continuous learning

Job benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

* Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

 

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

 

Everyone's welcome here
At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow.
We hire based on skills, potential, and how you work. Your age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background don't come into it. If you don't meet every requirement in this ad, apply anyway. We know great candidates don’t always tick every box and some of our best hires didn't either. We are looking forward to your application!

Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the role

We are looking for a manufacturing quality engineer to own the quality and reliability of the Gravis hardware package that turns regular excavators into awesome, autonomous machines. You will work with our engineering and production team in Zurich defining and implementing quality measures like incoming inspections, supply chain validations, failure analysis and product return teardowns to enable our custom AI hardware a safe and reliable operation of heavy machines. You are capable of working both independently and with others, and are intrinsically driven to solve challenging applied problems with a rigorous attention to detail and an exploratory imagination.

You are our first quality hire. There is no dedicated quality team, no lab, and no playbook; you will design the test / fixture / process and then go build it. 


What you will do

  • Design and implement testing systems, jigs and fixtures from incoming inspection to product shipping

Cash flow is the fuel behind every hire we make and every GPU we spin up — and right now, that process runs on scrappy startup instincts more than scalable systems. We're hiring an AR Specialist to change that: someone who can take full ownership of collections, chase down what's owed without losing the relationship, and build the reporting and processes that let Finance actually see around corners. You'll sit at the intersection of Finance, Sales, Operations, and Customer Success, which means your work is never just about invoices — it's about making sure the whole revenue engine runs cleanly as we scale. If you get real satisfaction from replacing chaos with a system that just works, this role was built for you.

Build the systems, not just run them

  • Work with Sales to make sure billing is accurate from the first invoice

  • Help build the scalable AR playbook a high-growth startup actually needs

Report on what matters

  • Put together weekly AR aging and collections reports for leadership

  • Track DSO, collection effectiveness, and overdue balances like they're your own scorecard

  • Support audits and keep documentation clean for compliance

Qualifications/Nice to haves:

  • Hands-on experience with Tesorio or similar AR automation/collections platforms

  • Experience supporting enterprise or B2B customers

  • Familiarity with SaaS billing models, contracts, and revenue operations

jobs.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.


This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.


What You'll Do

  • Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

  • Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

  • Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm.

  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

  • Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

  • Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

  • Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

  • Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

  • Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.

What You Bring

  • Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

  • Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

  • Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

  • Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

  • A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

  • Native level french speaking.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

  • Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

  • Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

  • Experience working with platform or API products

  • Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

  • Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Paris office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm.

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  • Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  • Technical interview with some of our Engineering team

  • Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads

  • Home case and presentation at our Paris office - Join us for a lunch, a discovery meeting and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

jobs.title: Propulsion Data & Modeling Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

We want you as a talented Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer to contribute to the development, testing, analysis, prediction and refinement of the functional architecture for Nyx Earth Propulsion System Development Models.

In order to derisk and gain confidence on the flight propulsion system, different development models are being built in order to run a multitude of tests spanning from functional tests, cold flows to system level hot fires. This testing will allow for the verification and validation of all the propulsion subsystems. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between design and hardware testing for the Nyx spacecraft propulsion system. As such, you will work closely with both the design and testing teams to ensure seamless integration and validation of propulsion subsystems.

You will report to the Propulsion Development Models Principal Engineer.

Key responsibilities:

In your capacity as a Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the development of analysis, post processing, and prediction tools that can support testing and design activities linked to the propulsion sub-systems.

Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include:

During the Design Phase:

  • Work closely with the pressure and feed system engineers to define the best configuration of the test setups, ensuring a high level of representativeness and testability to conduct all fluid modelling and analyses to verify repeatability of the test rigs with the flight systems and to perform test predictions.

  • Support on the creation of test plans for propulsion subsystems (from a modeling perspective), including data acquisition, analysis, and reporting to ensure the performance of the system can be assessed.

  • Design and develop propulsion analysis and post processing tools, to support testing activities and design maturation

  • Work in close collaboration with the pressure and feed system engineers to ensure the anchoring of the different fluidic models and assess against test data

During testing phase:

  • Provide on-site support during propulsion test campaigns, working closely with the test operator and test conductor.

  • Perform test campaigns, analysing in real-time, through different test parameters and ensure test results with timely resolution of any anomaly arising during testing.

  • Conduct pre-test and post-test reviews and elaborate the test reports.

  • Update and correlate the fluidic models based on test results.

  • Provide actionable insights to identify key performance indicators and potential critical scenarios

What we would love to see from you:

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in a related Engineering discipline.

  • +3 years of related experience in complex fluid systems, fluidic modeling, data analysis and data post processing.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and combustion principles.

  • Familiarity with test facilities, or storable propulsion systems is an asset

  • Experience in propulsion systems storable or cryogenic fluidic systems is a plus.

  • Proficiency in python for fluid analyses, data post processing and model anchoring.

  • Experience in EcosimPro (or similar software) for the high fidelity analysis of numerical twins.

  • Proficiency in conducting fluid analyses using classical hand calculations

  • Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Fluency in English.

Skills and Behaviours:

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks.

  • Strong team player with a proactive mindset.

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done.

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business.

  • Demonstrates behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

  • Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry.

  • Nice to have, Ecosim experience

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.
