jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
About Lemon.io

Lemon.io is a profitable, growing talent marketplace that connects vetted senior engineers with companies that need them. We’ve been in business for 10 years, have 60 people across Ukraine, Europe, Canada, and the US, and process over $16M in annual GMV. We compress the traditional 2–5 week hiring timeline down to 24–48 hours through a curated, pre-vetted supply of developers.

Hiring is still broken. Recruiters spend weeks building candidate pipelines on traditional platforms, burning energy on unqualified leads. We’re building the product that changes that. Giving recruiters qualified, vetted candidates within 24 hours without the grind. This is a pivotal moment: we’re transitioning from a services-driven marketplace to a technology-driven platform. We need an engineering leader who can drive that transformation.

The Role

You will own engineering at Lemon.io. You’ll lead a growing team of engineers, make critical architecture and prioritization decisions, and be directly accountable for the speed and quality of what we ship. This is not a management-layer role. You’ll be hands-on, deeply involved in product decisions, and working side by side with the founder.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical roadmap and make sure every engineering effort maps directly to business impact. No features for features’ sake.
  • Lead and grow an engineering team that ships fast, iterates constantly, and treats complexity as a cost.
  • Tackle the hard, multi-layered problem: automated vetting, intelligent matching at scale, demand-side bottlenecks. And figure out where the real leverage is.
  • Make hard prioritization calls. Decide what we build, what we skip, and what we kill.
  • Work directly with the founder and product team to define what success looks like before writing a single line of code.
  • Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy.

Who You Are:

  • Product-minded, business-first
  • Obsessed with simplicity
  • First principles thinker
  • Fast. Bias toward action

Experience:

  • You’ve led engineering teams (5–30+ people) at a startup or high-growth company.
  • You have hands-on experience with modern stacks and are comfortable with AI/ML tooling.
  • You’ve worked in a distributed, async-first team.

Why Lemon.io:

  • Profitable and growing. No fundraising pressure, real business fundamentals.
  • A pivotal moment: you’re not maintaining an engine, you’re building one. The product roadmap is wide open.
  • Direct access to the founder. No layers. Your decisions ship.
  • A massive, unsolved problem: hiring is still broken. We’re building the product that makes it radically faster for companies to find qualified engineers.
  • A team of 60 people who move fast, care deeply, and have survived the hard years together.

jobs.title: Phone Sales Agent - Restock
jobs.description:
Phone Sales Agent, Restock:

We are seeking a motivated and dedicated Phone Sales Agent to join our Restock team. In this role, you’ll reach out to loyal customers who are running low on the products they already know and love, and help them reorder before they run out.

These are warm conversations with people who have already bought from us and already like what we sell. You’re not cold calling. You’re the person who calls at exactly the right moment, makes reordering easy, and keeps their routine uninterrupted. This is a base pay + commission position with uncapped earning potential, making it perfect for individuals who thrive in a performance-driven environment.

What You’ll Do:

  • Call, text, and email existing customers whose supply is running low, and secure the reorder before they run out.

  • Work an assigned queue of reorder opportunities daily, following the established call and follow-up cadence.

  • Review each customer’s purchase history and order details before you dial, so every conversation is accurate and personalized.

  • Recommend the right product and the right quantity based on where the customer is in their routine.

  • Introduce complementary products that pair well with what the customer already uses, and grow the value of every order.

  • Follow up persistently and professionally across phone, SMS, and email to keep customers engaged and drive conversion.

  • Build rapport with repeat customers so they look forward to hearing from you.

  • Maintain accurate records of every customer interaction and sales activity in our CRM.

  • Meet or exceed individual sales targets on a weekly and monthly basis.

What You Bring to The Table:

  • Strong work ethic and self-motivation to drive sales results.

  • Comfort and proficiency with manual dialing and reaching out to leads.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage customers via phone, email, and text.

  • Comfort working inside a CRM and order management system, with strong attention to detail on customer records.

  • A consultative approach, with the instinct to listen first and sell second.

  • A positive attitude and a passion for sales.

  • Ability to work independently and handle rejection with resilience.

  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Prior experience in phone sales or telemarketing is a plus, but not required.

Technical Must Have’s:

  • We require a stable internet connection (50+mbps Up & down)capable of supporting seamless voice and zoom communications, and data transfer, with an Octane Speed of 20,000 or greater (https://chromium.github.io/octane/).

  • A backup system for power and internet.

  • A fast and reliable laptop or desktop computer, with working camera, and a working noise-cancelling headset. You will be on Zoom with your team throughout the day.

Compensation:

  • Base pay

  • 4+% commission on sales revenue (minus refunds). Your commission rate tiers up as you hit higher performance levels, so top producers earn a higher percentage on the same revenue.

  • Uncapped earning potential

  • Weekly and monthly performance bonuses, including top average order value, top weekly sales, QA excellence, and perfect attendance.

Schedule:

  • Full time (35-45 hrs per week)

  • Schedules vary between 9:00am and 7:00pm CT

  • Must be available to work weekends

Department

Outbound Sales

Locations

Multiple locations

Remote status

Fully Remote

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.

  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.

jobs.title: Senior SEO & Organic Growth Strategist
jobs.description:

The Opportunity

As a trusted advisor to fast-growing B2B SaaS companies, you'll join an elite team rated 5/5 ★★★★★ on Glassdoor, where 99% of team members recommend us to their peers.

What Sets You Apart

You're an ideal fit if you:

  • Can lead senior client conversations with clarity, confidence, and commercial judgment
  • Translate technical SEO insights into plain-English business recommendations
  • Connect SEO initiatives to pipeline, revenue, retention, and client priorities
  • Build trust with clients by communicating clearly, proactively, and directly
  • Get energized by analyzing data and uncovering actionable insights
  • Know how to turn messy SEO data into a clear story and next steps
  • Are comfortable challenging assumptions, clarifying tradeoffs, and guiding clients toward decisions
  • Love staying ahead of emerging SEO trends, especially in AI and semantic search
  • Embrace our core values:
    • Give a Sh!t
    • Always Be in It To Win It
    • Be Obsessed with Serving Others
    • Practice a Growth Mindset
    • When We Fail, We Don't Lose the Lesson

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership — 40%

  • Develop comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with B2B SaaS business goals
  • Lead strategic client communications, monthly/quarterly reviews, and senior stakeholder conversations
  • Create and present clear performance narratives that explain results, tradeoffs, risks, and next actions
  • Turn data, rankings, traffic, pipeline, and conversion signals into practical SEO recommendations
  • Push client conversations toward decisions, priorities, and committed next steps
  • Drive innovation in AI-enhanced SEO strategies

Client Success — 40%

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of 3–5 B2B SaaS clients
  • Build trust with senior marketing, demand generation, product marketing, and executive stakeholders
  • Lead strategic planning sessions, performance reviews, and client calls with confidence
  • Proactively identify risks, opportunities, blockers, and next steps before the client has to ask
  • Own follow-through by making sure client conversations end with clear actions, owners, and timelines
  • Communicate progress, risks, and recommendations in a way clients can understand and act on

Technical Excellence — 20%

  • Guide technical SEO implementation and optimization
  • Identify technical, content, and authority-building opportunities that can improve organic performance
  • Develop and optimize conversion-focused SEO funnels
  • Integrate GA4, GTM, and reporting tools to generate useful performance insights
  • Recommend and guide advanced schema markup strategies
  • Prioritize SEO recommendations based on business impact, effort, and implementation realities

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of SEO experience, with at least 2 year focused on B2B SaaS
  • Previous experience in a client-facing SEO strategy role where you owned client communication, not just execution
  • Proven track record of driving organic growth for B2B or enterprise clients
  • Strong portfolio of successful client relationships and retention
  • Deep understanding of technical SEO, content strategy, analytics, and SEO performance measurement
  • Experience with GA4, GTM, and modern SEO tools
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to lead client calls, explain SEO recommendations clearly, and write concise client-ready updates

One of my life's best decisions was to join PBS. Here's why:

We believe in building our people so they can build the business.

Ready to Help Make B2B SaaS Companies Unstoppable?

If you can combine SEO expertise, business judgment, and clear client communication, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Internationally located (not in US, CA, UK, NZ, or AU)

Beyond the Basics — What Will Make You Successful

  • Noticing & Curiosity — You pick up on things others miss and ask "why" more than once because the first answer is rarely the whole story. jobs.title: Product Lead (Strategy + Full Stack)
jobs.description:
Do you want to join the company behind Northern Europe’s largest crypto and stock market comparison platforms? Do you want to own the product roadmap end to end and build it yourself? Do you want to decide what we build next as we expand globally?

We’re looking for a hands-on Product Lead to join our small but driven 100% remote team. This is a rare hybrid role: roughly 60% product leadership (roadmap, prioritization, specs, analytics) and 40% full stack development. You’ll work alongside our full-stack web developer, and as we expand the Product Team, your focus will shift increasingly toward product and team leadership, running 1-on-1s, recruiting, and building your own team to improve our products, with a clear path toward Head of Product.

Who are Optimizee Group?

Optimizee Group has been delivering results for 450+ partners worldwide through financial comparison platforms since 2017. Our portfolio includes CryptoRunner.com (the largest cryptocurrency comparison platform in Northern Europe), InvestoRunner.com (the largest stock market comparison platform in Sweden), and CreditRunner.com (a new credit card comparison platform launching soon).

Our mission is to build the world’s biggest and most trusted portfolio of financial comparison platforms, helping millions of people make better financial decisions. To date, we’ve generated over 8 million views and delivered more than 1.8 million referrals to our partners. With approximately 44,000 monthly active users and 35,000+ subscribers, you’ll have a strong existing audience and foundation to build on.

In 2026, we relaunched our websites on fully custom-built platforms, replacing our previous WordPress setup (see full tech stack below). The new platforms are connected to our in-house admin system, with integrations to multiple AI models and third-party API providers, giving us greater flexibility, scalability, and control as we grow. AI is deeply integrated into the admin system and across development, content, and operations. Over the past year we’ve shipped 970+ updates, and our product backlog holds 350+ tasks. Your job: review our platforms and product backlog, decide what to prioritize, and turn ideas into new features — with direct support from the founder, a former web developer who built our first platforms line by line.

Why Join Optimizee Group:

  • Be Part of a Market Leader – Help shape our established platforms, our group includes the largest stock and crypto comparison platforms in Northern Europe.
  • Full Ownership, Real Impact – High autonomy, meaningful ownership, and the opportunity to influence company decisions.
  • Join Early, Grow Faster – Join a small, fast-growing team where your role, responsibilities, and opportunities grow alongside the company.
  • Join an Ambitious Team – Work alongside high-performing teammates who value ownership, continuous improvement, and long-term thinking.

Benefits:

  • 🚀 Clear path to Head of Product as the team scales
  • 🤝 Work directly with the founder on strategy and growth
  • ⏰ High autonomy, flexible working hours, and strong ownership
  • 📈 Competitive compensation package + performance-based bonus
  • 🌎 Fully remote role — work from most countries worldwide
  • 🧰 All the AI and tools you need to do your best work
  • 💻 Home office setup — laptop and required equipment provided
  • ✈️ Annual business trips for team building, networking, and fun (past trips include Dubai, Singapore & Hong Kong)

Responsibilities:

  • Own the product roadmap across our platforms — prioritize, spec, and drive execution from idea to launch
  • Build and ship features hands-on alongside our web developer, improving site architecture, performance, and conversion flows
  • Lead and grow the product team — manage team members, run 1-on-1s and performance reviews, and take part in recruitment as we scale
  • Build our engineering workflow — set up development routines, code review, testing and deployment processes so multiple developers can ship safely, with documentation so knowledge is never siloed
  • Make data-first decisions — turn user data, market insights, and analytics into actions that move traffic, conversion, and revenue per visitor

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of full stack development experience — you can independently build, deploy, and maintain production web applications, and set up the workflows (Git, code review, CI/CD) for your team to do the same
  • A track record you can show — live products, sites, or projects you’ve built or led, and the ability to walk us through the decisions behind them
  • Strong backend, database, and architecture skills — data accuracy is critical to us, as we track and report statistics to 450+ partners
  • Proven product ownership with commercial instincts — you’ve decided what to build, not just built what was decided, and you understand how those decisions translate into revenue
  • Independent and async-first — you drive your own work in a small remote team and document decisions clearly in writing
  • Genuine interest in cryptocurrencies, investing, and personal finance — and high standards for what a great comparison platform looks like

Tech Stack:

  • Backend: PHP 8.2+ / Laravel 12 — one codebase powering the public sites and our in-house admin CMS/API
  • Frontend: Server-rendered Laravel Blade with Alpine.js, Livewire (admin), Tailwind CSS, and Vite — no React/Next.js
  • Database: MySQL, with Redis for cache, queues, and realtime (Laravel Reverb)
  • Infrastructure: Linux VPS with Nginx and PHP-FPM, automated deploys via GitHub Actions
  • Integrations: AI models via multiple providers (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) plus third-party API integrations powering our platforms and admin system

Our Team Values:

  • Full Ownership – If you see it, you own it. Take full ownership from start to finish.
  • Data First – Data first, decision second. Always put data first before making decisions.
  • Long Game – We are building for decades, not quarters. Always play the long game.
  • AI Speed – The fastest teams win. Use AI to move like a team ten times our size.

Location & Availability:

This is a fully remote position; however, candidates should be able to maintain reasonable overlap with European business hours (CET/CEST) for meetings and team collaboration. We welcome applications from candidates worldwide, except residents of the United States.

Compensation:

USD 48,000–90,000 gross per year, consisting of a fixed base salary (USD 48,000–60,000, based on experience) and a revenue-tied performance bonus. You’ll receive paid time off and public holidays in line with the standards of your country of employment. Additional benefits and reimbursements may apply depending on your location. We employ through a global HR partner, enabling compliant employment in 95+ countries.

Apply:

Send in your application here: https://forms.gle/4yqiWvhiCMnC6xdx7

Hiring process: 1-minute intro video → intro call with the founder → portfolio walkthrough → offer. Applications reviewed continuously, start date by agreement.

jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description:
The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes:

• Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings.

• Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation.

• Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes.

The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review

No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

jobs.description:
For thousands of years, maps have provided humans with the knowledge they need to make decisions. As a Maps Evaluator, you will have the opportunity to provide ground truth for your town, city or country.

 

At Peroptyx, we are looking for Data Analysts who will review mapping data for digital mapping applications. Your research capabilities will validate and ensure that the navigation of certain routes are accurate and safe.

 

As part of this role you will verify that business names and opening hours are correct. You will check that the distance from a starting point to an end destination is listed accurately, resulting in better user experiences.

 

With this job you can plan your days around this highly flexible working schedule, work weekends or late evenings, all from the comfort of your own office. The flexibility of our roles minimizes the impact on your daily routine.

 

So, whether you are a student looking to earn as you learn, a retiree looking for a new challenge, a part-time/full time professional or a work from home parent, Peroptyx has the right role for you!

 

Benefits

  • Work up to 20 hours per week.

  • Earn a competitive rate of pay.

  • Develop your research skills.

  • Avoid the long commute.

  • Work from the comfort of your home office.

  • Enjoy the flexibility of setting your own working hours!

 

Ideal Candidate

  • Fluent in English

  • Excellent research skills.

  • Excellent local knowledge of your home country.

  • Good understanding and general knowledge of the geography and culture of Canada.

  • Analytical mindset.

 

Job Requirements

  • Must be living in Canada for a minimum of 5 consecutive years.

  • Must pass an online open-book exam that can verify your full understanding of the material and concepts.

  • Must be willing to work a minimum of 10 hours and up to 20 hours per week depending on task availability.

  • Good working knowledge of search engines, map applications and familiarity with social media platforms.

  • Strong ability to learn, understand and apply multiple sets of different instructions.

  • All work must be of an independent nature.

 

Apply Online Today!

jobs.title: Senior React.js Full-stack Developer
jobs.location: Europe, LATAM, APAC, the U.S., Canada
jobs.description:
Are you a talented Senior Developer looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

What we offer:

  • The rate depends on your seniority level, skills and experience. We've already paid out over $11M to our engineers.
  • No more hunting for clients or negotiating rates — let us handle the business side of things so you can focus on what you do best.
  • We'll manually find the best project for you according to your skills and preferences.
  • Choose a schedule that works best for you. It’s possible to communicate async or minimally overlap within team working hours.
  • We respect your seniority so you can expect no micromanagement or screen trackers.
  • Communicate directly with the clients. Most of them have technical backgrounds. Sounds good, yeah?
  • We will support you from the time you submit the application throughout all cooperation stages.
  • Most of our projects involve working in a fast-paced startup environment. We hope you like it as much as we do.
  • Through our community, we will connect you with the best developers from more than 75 countries.

We have several open positions for Full-Stack React.js Developers - please see the details below. We also have some backend positions; the full list is included below as well.

Requirements for the Senior React & Python Position:

  • 4+ years of software development experience.

Commercial experience:

  • React.js 3+ years & Python 3+ years

    OR
    React.js 2+ years & Python 5+ years
    OR
    React.js 5+ years & Python 2+ years

  • Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure is required.

Requirements for the Senior Node & React Position:

  • 5+ years of software development experience

Commercial experience:

  • React.js: 3+ years, Node.js: 5+ years, and Next.js: 2+ years
    OR
    React.js: 5+ years, Node.js: 3+ years, and Next.js: 2+ years
  • Expertise in AWS, TypeScript and AI-assisted coding is a must.

Requirements for the Senior Ruby & React Position:

  • 5+ years of software development experience.

Commercial experience:

  • React.js 2+ years & Ruby/Ruby on Rails 5+ years
    OR
    React.js 5+ years & Ruby/Ruby on Rails 2+ years
  • Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure is required.

Other requirements:

  • Strong technical skills: as a Senior Developer, you are expected to be able to create projects from scratch and have a deep understanding of application architecture.
  • Clear and effective communication in English — advanced ability to discuss business tasks, justify decisions, and communicate issues. Good self-presentation is also essential for upcoming client calls.
  • Strong self-organizational skills — ability to work full-time remotely with no supervision.
  • Reliability — we want to trust you and expect that you won’t let us and the client down.
  • Adaptability and Flexibility — the ability to onboard the project promptly after accepting it and start delivering results quickly.

Sounds good for you? Apply now and join the Lemon.io community!

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

We're placing Senior Developers (4+ yrs commercial experience) across AI Agent Architecture, AI Automation Architecture, AI Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, eact & Golang, Golang, React & Java, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, iOS & Swift, Flutter & Firebase, Solutions Engineer, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, DevOps, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & Angular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Data Engineering, Project Management, Product Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Node, React Native & React, React Native & Ruby, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Data Annotation, Angular, Python & Node, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, UI/UX Design, Animation, Graphic Design, React & Node & React Native, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering and more. Reach out and we'll match you.

We do not provide visa assistance, and our cooperation model does not include the benefits typically offered with direct hire.

We work with developers from 75+ countries across Europe, Latin America, North America (the U.S. and Canada), selected countries in Asia (Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, and Israel), Oceania (Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea), and Africa (including Morocco and South Africa).

jobs.title: Software engineer
jobs.description:
Sticker Mule is building the Internet's most lucrative commerce platform by combining software, manufacturing, and AI into one fully integrated stack. No print company, or pure software company for that matter, can match what we're doing. We're privately owned, profitable, and doing 9-figures in annual revenue with no meddlesome investors.

 

How we work

  1. Small, autonomous teams that own products end-to-end.

  2. Prioritize what matters right now and pivot instantly when needed.

  3. Ship across web and mobile from the same codebase. We use Go, TypeScript, React, Expo, GraphQL, Postgres, and run on GCP.

  4. Use AI aggressively to push the limit of what we can do.

  5. Move fast, build for the masses, and deprioritize edge cases.

  6. Fully remote from 40+ countries and collaborate using Asana and Slack.

 

Requirements

  1. You are an exceptional full-stack software engineer.

  2. You use AI aggressively and write well in English.

     

What you will work on

You'll help build and scale Sticker Mule Pro - a suite of software tools for creators and businesses:

  1. Stores (Shopify alternative)

  2. AI tools (internal and customer-facing)

  3. Notify (Mailchimp alternative)

  4. Reply (Zendesk alternative)

  5. Hire Me (Contra alternative)

  6. Mobile apps

 

Compensation

  1. Salary: $150,000–$250,000 USD

  2. $20,000 signing bonus

  3. 4 weeks vacation + country-specific holidays

  4. Fully remote
